description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform upgrade and bootloader management for OpenWRT targets, including image checking, copying configurations, bootloader upgrades, and overall system upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and partition layout of a given image, ensuring it's valid for upgrade purposes.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration to the device's partition.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the device's bootloader using GRUB with the specified device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall system upgrade, including partition updates and bootloader configuration.
